tasks.title: Bundle local Moonshine streaming STT and connect finalized speech to live LLM answers
acceptance: Bundled runtime and English model with no runtime download
Bounded rolling transcript and streamed answers
Pause/Stop destroy capture and speech workers
Independent capture lifecycle review and synthetic E2E
tasks.notes: Bundled runtimes built for macOS arm64 and Ubuntu x86_64. Six synthetic E2E cases cover speech/answers, control EOF, full pipe, shared terminal, startup Stop and authorization. Rust/Python gates and GUI self-test pass. Review findings addressed and confirmed by narrow follow-up: terminal flags preserved, reader-to-UI queues bounded, E2E deadlines absolute, Swift reader switched to a POSIX readiness read with a self-test regression. Linux packaged execution is verified on Ubuntu 26.04.1 x86_64 (CLI smoke tests, bundled runtime `--check`, GTK import, capture-rule suites); real audio-device permissions and live desktop-session use remain unverified. STREAM-STT-003 includes separate speaker-separation work. See docs/MOONSHINE.md.

tasks.title: Linux floating overlay with best-effort screen-capture exclusion
acceptance: overlay_guard.py session detection, ExclusionPlan and capability_report implemented and unit tested
floating_overlay.py renders live JSONL events, never steals focus, and stays visible across focus changes and screen shares
Panel stays visible on any share state; only an explicit user hide/close changes visibility
Compositor capture rules (niri, Hyprland 0.53+, KDE Plasma/KWin 6.7+) are explicit, reversible and validated; configured is reported separately from runtime-verified
socket_stream overlay launches the overlay without performing capture itself
Capability matrix documented honestly; no claim of universal invisibility
On GNOME Wayland the panel uses the XWayland dock layer so it stays above fullscreen windows without taking focus

verification.target: Ubuntu 26.04.1, GNOME Shell 50.1, mutter 18, GTK 3.24.52, Wayland
verification.panel: app_id=socket_stream_overlay (xdg_toplevel.set_app_id); GNOME default uses GDK_BACKEND=x11 and _NET_WM_WINDOW_TYPE_DOCK + SKIP_TASKBAR/SKIP_PAGER/ABOVE, centred, above a fullscreen window, no override-redirect, opacity 0.94 with RGBA visual; native X11 keeps WM_CLASS=socket_stream_overlay, Override Redirect State=yes, notification type
verification.not_verified: per-window whole-screen capture exclusion on GNOME 50/mutter 18 (no such API); niri/Hyprland/KWin rules are unit-tested and config-validated only

tasks.title: Structured accessibility-tree reading with token budget
acceptance: Helpers emit schema-1 JSON tree nodes with role, text, focused, bounds, image and protected fields
A11yTree::parse rejects schema mismatch and malformed JSON
Focused, tree, text and auto render modes are unit tested
Token budget bounds max_tokens, max_nodes, max_depth and max_chars and sets truncated
Protected nodes are skipped and their text is never rendered
image_regions returns image/graphic nodes largest first

verification.macOS: installed bundle read real Terminal and Google Chrome trees through the focused-window root; the global menu bar is filtered; auto rendering falls back to tree mode when only the window is focused. Regression tests added in crates/socket_stream_core/src/a11y.rs.

tasks.title: Region OCR for image/graphic accessibility nodes
acceptance: extract_region_text crops with sips/magick/convert and never OCRs the whole screen as a fallback
extract_regions_text skips regions below min_pixels and caps at max_regions
Regions below the pixel threshold return an empty string, not an error
Results are cached by screenshot path and region in a bounded map
OCR stays opt-in and is never used when accessibility text is sufficient
Region OCR reports the ocr source badge

tasks.title: Configurable global shortcuts for every feature
acceptance: Twelve stable actions are defined and mapped to default accelerators
Accelerator::parse and display round-trip; duplicate accelerators and unknown actions are rejected
hotkeys list, hotkeys init and hotkeys print work; init refuses to overwrite without --force
hide_overlay hides the panel immediately and is remembered by the behavioural guard
Every shortcut is reachable from the UI without a keyboard
Out-of-focus globals are documented as requiring the desktop's own hotkey tool

tasks.title: Native Codex/ChatGPT device authorization
acceptance: Device flow uses only official HTTPS auth.openai.com endpoints with redirects disabled
Credentials are stored 0600 in SocketStream's own config dir, never the Codex CLI's files
Tokens and user codes are never logged; Debug redacts them
Polling is bounded by MAX_POLLS and response bodies by MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
codex-login --native, codex-status --native and codex-logout --native --confirm work without the CLI
CLI-backed behaviour is unchanged when --native is absent
